question: M is the incentre of the ΔXYZ. If ∠YXZ + ∠YMZ = 150 degree, then what is the value of ∠YXZ?
solution:
Given: 

M is the incentre of ΔXYZ.

∠YXZ + ∠YMZ = 150° 

Concept Used:

If M is the incentre.

∠YMZ = 90° + ∠YXZ/2

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cdbab085d7b23f93eb6998e6f99512c7d23b7c2d20c7e38fddb1249de1d72861.png] 

∠YXZ + ∠YMZ = 150° 

∠YMZ = 150 - ∠YXZ

M is the incentre.

∠YMZ = 90° + ∠YXZ/2

150 - ∠YXZ = 90° + ∠YXZ/2

60 = 3∠YXZ/2

∠YXZ = 40° 

∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.
